comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Using a Letter of Appreciation from Seafarers item and selecting the job endorsement benefit means you can pick up certain job cards from NPCs at sea for a set period of time. The Archaeologist card can be obtained from Diogo Ortiz (Portuguese NPC sailing in a fleet of x3 Galleons from Porto to Lisbon) this way, without having to go through the Troy chain -- you will probably want to do it one day all the same, but it's nice to have other options. Cheers.

Source: gvo.gamedb.info/wiki/?RescueNPC
